name: ERR reentrant eval set -e;
script: set -e; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; eval false; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant eval set -E;
script: set -E; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; eval false; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant eval set -eE;
script: set -eE; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; eval false; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant source plain
script: printf 'false\n' > job; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; source ./job

name: ERR reentrant source set -e;
script: printf 'false\n' > job; set -e; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; source ./job; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant source set -E;
script: printf 'false\n' > job; set -E; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; source ./job; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant source set -eE;
script: printf 'false\n' > job; set -eE; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; source ./job; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant dot plain
script: printf 'false\n' > job; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; . ./job

name: ERR reentrant dot set -e;
script: printf 'false\n' > job; set -e; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; . ./job; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant dot set -E;
script: printf 'false\n' > job; set -E; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; . ./job; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant dot set -eE;
script: printf 'false\n' > job; set -eE; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; . ./job; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant nested eval plain
script: trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; eval 'eval false'

name: ERR reentrant nested eval set -e;
script: set -e; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; eval 'eval false'; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant nested eval set -eE;
script: set -eE; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; eval 'eval false'; echo unreachable

name: ERR reentrant eval conditional exclusion
script: set -e; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; if eval false; then echo unexpected; fi; echo after

name: ERR reentrant source conditional exclusion
script: printf 'false\n' > job; set -e; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; if source ./job; then echo unexpected; fi; echo after

name: ERR reentrant dot conditional exclusion
script: printf 'false\n' > job; set -e; trap 'echo recovery:$?' ERR; if . ./job; then echo unexpected; fi; echo after
